title: Niclosamide as a potential antivirulence agent disrupting quorum sensing in Pseudomonas aeruginosa: A molecular and in silico approach.
authors: Mohamed, Malik Suliman; Soltane, Raya; Alatwi, Eid; Alasiri, Ahlam; Almulla, Nuha; Abdelkader, Karim; Sayed, Ahmed M
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接和MD模拟探究药物niclosamide与细菌QS调控蛋白LasR的相互作用，属于蛋白-小分子而非蛋白-DNA互作，但MD/对接方法可迁移至TF-DNA体系，故给予中档评分。
abstract: Pseudomonas aeruginosa is a formidable pathogen linked to various challenging infections. Quorum sensing (QS) plays a pivotal role in regulating the virulence factors of P. aeruginosa. Targeting QS represents a promising strategy for mitigating P. aeruginosa virulence. This study explores the potential of niclosamide (NIC) as an antivirulence agent, emphasizing its effects on biofilm formation, pigment production, and its molecular interaction with the QS regulator, LasR. A comprehensive methodology was employed, encompassing in-silico, molecular, and in vitro analyses to assess the antivirulence properties of NIC. Sub-inhibitory concentrations of NIC (64 mug/ml) were evaluated for their capacity to inhibit biofilm formation and pigment production in P. aeruginosa. NIC resulted in a 45.4 % reduction in biofilm formation, a 48.8 % decrease in pyocyanin production, and a 41.3 % reduction in rhamnolipid production. Furthermore, NIC displayed a dose-dependent antagonistic effect on LasR, with an IC50 of 5.82 +/- 0.17 muM, without any noted agonistic activity. Molecular modeling and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations indicated that NIC interacts with LasR, hindering its dimerization and destabilizing its structure. These findings were corroborated by sedimentation velocity experiments and thermal shift assays. NIC shows considerable promise as an antivirulence agent against P. aeruginosa by disrupting the LasR-mediated QS system. Through its interaction with LasR, NIC inhibits biofilm formation and diminishes the production of critical virulence factors, making P. aeruginosa less virulent and more vulnerable to conventional antibiotics and immune responses.
abstract_zh: 铜绿假单胞菌是一种与多种难治性感染相关的强效病原体。群体感应（quorum sensing, QS）在调控铜绿假单胞菌的毒力因子中发挥关键作用。靶向QS代表了一种缓解铜绿假单胞菌毒力的有前景策略。本研究探讨了氯硝柳胺（niclosamide, NIC）作为抗毒力剂的潜力，重点研究其对生物膜形成、色素产生的影响，及其与QS调控因子LasR的分子相互作用。采用综合方法，包括计算机模拟、分子和体外分析，以评估NIC的抗毒力特性。评估了亚抑制浓度的NIC（64 μg/ml）抑制铜绿假单胞菌生物膜形成和色素产生的能力。NIC使生物膜形成减少45.4%，绿脓菌素产生减少48.8%，鼠李糖脂产生减少41.3%。此外，NIC对LasR表现出剂量依赖的拮抗作用，IC50为5.82 ± 0.17 μM，且未观察到任何激动活性。分子建模和分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟表明，NIC与LasR相互作用，阻碍其二聚化并使其结构不稳定。这些发现通过沉降速度实验和热位移实验得到证实。NIC通过破坏LasR介导的QS系统，显示出作为抗铜绿假单胞菌毒力剂的显著潜力。通过与LasR的相互作用，NIC抑制生物膜形成并减少关键毒力因子的产生，使铜绿假单胞菌毒力降低，更易受常规抗生素和免疫反应的影响。
